tagline: Design and inspect an evidence-first Aiven data stack for AI agents.
introduction: A data-platform companion for Aiven: it maps a workload to managed PostgreSQL, Kafka, OpenSearch, Valkey, ClickHouse and AI gateway patterns, designs replayable agent event logs and model evaluations, and, when the host grants a read-only Aiven connection, inspects real service state.
welcome: What are you building on Aiven? Describe the workload, or share a small redacted data flow, and I will propose the services, the failure checks and what to measure first.

capabilities.title: Map a workload to Aiven services
capabilities.description: Relate transactional, streaming, search, cache, analytics and model-routing needs to specific Aiven services and documentation, with the constraint that decides each choice.
outputs: service map with deciding constraints and documentation references

capabilities.title: Design a replayable agent event log
capabilities.description: Design a PostgreSQL outbox, Debezium change capture through Kafka Connect and keyed Kafka topics so every agent action can be replayed, deduplicated by an idempotency key and audited after a disconnect.
inputs: agent actions, data ownership and delivery requirements
outputs: topic, key and connector design with a duplicate-and-disconnect test plan

capabilities.title: Plan real-time guardrails on event streams
capabilities.description: Specify streaming rules that detect bursts, cost spikes or new destinations in agent or device events and emit an explicit pause signal for the host to enforce; states whether Flink or a Kafka consumer is the available implementation.
outputs: guardrail rules, pause-signal contract and evaluation cases

capabilities.title: Plan model evaluation through AI gateway
capabilities.description: Plan running the same behaviour cases across several models through the Aiven AI gateway and choosing the cheapest model that passes a stated quality gate, with billing and early-availability limits made explicit.
inputs: behaviour cases, quality gate and budget
outputs: evaluation matrix plan and routing decision criteria

capabilities.title: Design search, retrieval memory and caching
capabilities.description: Combine OpenSearch full-text and vector search, PostgreSQL pgvector and Valkey caching or rate limits for catalogue search, agent memory with provenance and repeated-question cost control.
inputs: content, query patterns and freshness needs
outputs: index, memory and cache design with relevance and staleness checks

capabilities.title: Plan usage metering and analytics
capabilities.description: Plan streaming usage and cost events from Kafka into ClickHouse for metering, reports and operational dashboards, separating measured usage from estimates.
outputs: analytics schema, ingestion path and metric definitions

capabilities.title: Plan Aiven infrastructure as code
capabilities.description: Plan declaring Aiven services with the Aiven Operator for Kubernetes or Terraform, per-environment projects and cross-region replication, so the stack is reviewable and reproducible.
outputs: resource layout, promotion flow and review checklist

capabilities.title: Inspect a connected Aiven project read-only
capabilities.description: With a host-granted read-only Aiven MCP connection, list services, states, metrics, logs and integrations and compare them with the intended design; never creates, changes or deletes resources.
inputs: host-granted read-only Aiven connection and the question to answer
outputs: observed service state with timestamps, gaps against the design and one next check

starterPrompts: Map my AI agent app to Aiven services: we store users and tasks, stream agent actions and need search.
Design a replayable event log for our agent so a duplicate message or a disconnect never repeats an action.
Plan how to compare three models on our 50 test cases through Aiven AI gateway and pick the cheapest that passes.
Review this redacted data flow for source-of-truth, retry and schema-evolution problems.

sources.title: Identify PostgreSQL slow queries
sources.summary: pg_stat_statements supports slow-query investigation; column names vary by PostgreSQL version. Query-plan inspection is a next step, not proof that a particular index helps.

sources.title: Repair PostgreSQL indexes
sources.summary: REINDEX addresses index corruption and can apply locks that interfere with normal database use; this is not general index-selection evidence.

sources.title: Monitor Kafka consumer groups
sources.summary: Extra consumers beyond partition count remain idle. Consumer group replication lag is the per-partition high-watermark minus group offset; lag requires investigation, not a single assumed cause.

sources.title: Best Use of Aiven
sources.summary: Official challenge text captured from the signed-in participant platform on 13 November 2026. Meaningful managed-data/service workflow owner. Required proof and limitations are recorded in the source-bound challenge packet.

sources.title: Create a Debezium source connector from PostgreSQL to Apache Kafka
sources.summary: Debezium reads committed changes from the PostgreSQL transaction log into Kafka topics for multiple consumers; Aiven supports several Debezium versions and advises pinning the connector version.

sources.title: Aiven for Apache Flink
sources.summary: Managed Flink SQL stream processing. The page states existing services remain supported and new stream-processing workloads go through the Aiven account manager, so availability must be confirmed.

sources.title: Aiven for OpenSearch
sources.summary: Managed OpenSearch for logs, application search and analytical aggregations, with OpenSearch Dashboards included.

sources.title: Aiven for Valkey
sources.summary: Managed in-memory Valkey, compatible with Redis OSS 7.2.4, for caching and other in-memory data structures.

sources.title: Aiven for ClickHouse
sources.summary: Managed columnar OLAP database for real-time analytical reports, with built-in integrations for Aiven for Kafka and Aiven for PostgreSQL.

sources.title: Use AI gateway with SDKs
sources.summary: Early availability. OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible access at ai.aiven.io; the aiven-model router is free to use, named models are billed at listed rates, and the gateway must be enabled for the organization.

sources.title: Aiven Operator for Kubernetes
sources.summary: Manages Aiven services as Kubernetes custom resources; requires an operator install, cluster admin access and a token held in a Kubernetes Secret.

sources.title: Aiven MCP server for managed services
sources.summary: MCP server for AI assistants to view and manage Aiven services; read-only mode and service scopes control which operations are available.
